name: heading
label: Heading
hint: Defaults to "What Is IT Asset Management?" when empty

name: eyebrow
label: Eyebrow label
hint: Optional small label above the heading

name: body
label: Body text
hint: Separate paragraphs with a blank line. Defaults to a short definition of ITAM when empty

name: style
label: Style
hint: Neutral is a white card; Tinted is a soft brand panel; Brand is a dark banner

name: icon
label: Icon
hint: Optional Font Awesome 4 class, such as fa-lightbulb-o

name: button1_label
label: Button 1 label
hint: Shown only when the label and a URL (or property) are set

name: button1_url
label: Button 1 URL
hint: Portal URL (?id=...), path, or full https link

name: button1_property
label: Button 1 URL property
hint: Instead of a URL, the name after x_1026751_itsm_ins.itam. of the property holding it, such as teams_channel_url

name: button2_url
label: Button 2 URL
hint: Portal URL (?id=...), path, or full https link

name: button2_property
label: Button 2 URL property
hint: Instead of a URL, the name after x_1026751_itsm_ins.itam. of the property holding it

name: show_email
label: Show email button
hint: Adds a button that emails the address in x_1026751_itsm_ins.itam.contact_email, when set

name: email_label
label: Email button label
hint: Defaults to "Email the program team" when empty
